message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: credit card fraud? The facts: defendant applied for credit card, then from April 2015 repeatedly made large malicious overdrafts, refused to repay, owed principal ~100k yuan. After the case, he and relatives repaid all principal, interest, penalty. He admits. Evidence confirms.

In Chinese criminal law, malicious overdraft on credit card is considered "信用卡诈骗罪" (Credit Card Fraud) under Article 196 of Criminal Law (formerly). The elements: using false information to obtain credit card, or using credit card for fraudulent purposes, or maliciously overdrawing and not repaying. So the crime is "信用卡诈骗罪". Also possibly "诈骗罪" (fraud) but specific is credit card fraud. The fact that he applied legitimately? He applied for a credit card, then maliciously overdrew. That is credit card fraud. Not theft, not embezzlement. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗罪<eoa>
